input: Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys other than knight_b8, and must also modify /turn/ply.num, since knight_b8 has repeatedly gone off plan.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_b8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false)
